reasons: The first term uses a fixed [5m] range; only $__rate_interval is allowed as a range, so the candidate violates a hard rule.

The Datadog query filters on {$scope,$host}. $host has prefix host and default *, so it should become a host matcher (e.g. host=~"$host" or the observed dataset label for it). The candidate drops it, which changes the set of series. The dataset observes only redis_version, so the correct host label name cannot be confirmed from the given data.
Quantity, unit (percent via *100 on hit ratio), and aggregation (avg of monotonic sums) match the Datadog formula. Outcome translated is appropriate since no functions are used.
